proposals.name: Repeated mis-targeted UI activation
proposals.description: Repeated clicks at changing coordinates fail to activate the intended control; a different interaction method later succeeds.

proposals.name: Wrong UI target activated
proposals.description: The action intended for a spreadsheet target activates a different control or dialog, preventing the intended selection.

proposals.name: Repeated ineffective modal dismissal
proposals.description: Repeated close, cancel, or escape attempts leave the same blocking modal visible without adapting targeting or strategy.

proposals.name: Online resource blocked by proxy or network path
proposals.description: A required or chosen online resource is visibly unreachable because of a proxy or network-path error, blocking that route.

proposals.name: Malformed command-entry key sequence
proposals.description: Input encoding or key-sequence construction enters unintended characters or fails to submit a command, requiring corrected entry.

proposals.name: Retrieved information does not match requested scope
proposals.description: The obtained information is narrower or differently structured than the requested scope, so it does not substantively satisfy the task.

proposals.name: Numeric entry appended in wrong field
proposals.description: A value intended for one numeric field is appended to the still-active different field, producing an incorrect combined value.

proposals.name: Required dialog action left incomplete
proposals.description: The interaction ends with required values still incorrect and the dialog unconfirmed, leaving the requested operation unapplied.
